about:
Slipyme is a technology company delivering end-to-end solutions across software, design, and digital media. Our mission is to integrate the disciplines we operate in and deliver scalable, sustainable, and high-quality products to our clients. We work across mobile, web, desktop, embedded, and gaming, building bespoke architectures and delivery models for every engagement.

Our software practice is built on customizable solution suites and modern industry standards. On the design side we cover graphic, brand, and product UI work — integrating outputs into our software projects or shipping them as standalone deliverables. We support our processes with transparent reporting and data-driven decision-making, with the client need at the center of every stage.

timeline.d: On October 30, 2021 we began operations as Slipyme Software with a five-person team. We built our product-development experience through early-stage freelance work.
On March 22, 2022 we established our corporate structure under the name Slipyme Company and began launching our own products.
Our product portfolio reached its founding goals. We redefined our strategic roadmap and built a mid-term growth plan.
After three years of steady operation we grew the team to 17. We exited the freelance model and focused fully on our own products.
We consolidated existing projects and transitioned to our next-generation product line. Three flagship products are planned for launch by the end of 2026.
